text:
sam: Heads up — token-level latency dashboard shows a gap for several routes after yesterday's kernel-selector deploy. p50/p95 look fine overall but the per-route breakdown is missing kvcache hit_rate tags, so the dashboard falls back to aggregate values.
irene: Hmm, seen that too. Is it missing at ingest time or dropped during export? :thinking:
devin: Looks like the statsd->OTel exporter we rolled two weeks ago strips tags with `.` in them. kvcache tags are like `kvcache.hit_rate` — exporter v1.3.0 had a bug where it flattens dots into nested attributes and our OPATH filter removes them.
luis: Repro steps I ran: `curl -XPOST http://statsd:8125 -d "kvcache.hit_rate:1|g|#route:chat,model:llama-13b"` -> not present in OTLP collector logs. We should confirm in collector trace logs.
ops-bot: deployment "kernel-selector/v2" updated by @devin — rollout 2026-02-14T03:21Z
sam: Correlated the dropout windows with the kernel selector canary timestamps. Also noticed a small token-latency spike for /chat-stream when kvcache hit_rate was missing. Could be the batching heuristics toggling fallback to smaller batches when cache hit unknown.
irene: For dashboards, the token-level breakdown uses `token_latency` with labels stage={kv_lookup,kernel,serialize}. If `kvcache.*` is missing we can't split by cache hit. Suggest adding a fallback label for unknown hits so dashboards don't disappear.
devin: Quick fix: bump exporter to v1.3.1 which preserves dotted tags (we have a PR). Can we canary it to eng-runtime? I can cut the image today.
luis: Meanwhile we need a backfill for the 6h window of missing metrics. We keep raw statsd payloads in blob-store for 7 days. I can run a backfill job to re-ingest ranges: start=1761228000,end=1761235200,parallel=8.
sam: Good. Let's scope: 1) canary exporter in eng-runtime (small pool), 2) run backfill for the 6h window, 3) update dashboards to show fallback label, 4) monitor token-latency p50/p95 per-route.
devin: Canary image: `ghcr.io/redwood/exporter:v1.3.1-canary` — will push and create canary deployment at `exporter-canary-eng-runtime`.
otto-bot: Backfill job created: backfill/metrics-replay-1761234567 by @luis — status: queued
luis: I'll start the backfill in 10m. Plan: run against blob-store with the fixed parser, write to temp metric namespace `replay.kvfix.*` then swap to main after quick checks. Will post progress.
irene: Also file a quick alert rule: if `kvcache.hit_rate` cardinality drops >50% from 1h baseline, alert to #eng-oncall. That would've caught this earlier.
sam: Thanks team. @devin let me know when canary is up and I'll validate dashboards. Re: downstream, need to coordinate with product metrics team for retrospective.
devin: Canary deployed to 2 nodes. Logs show dotted tags preserved. Running smoke queries now.
luis: Backfill started. 0/8 shards completed. ETA ~35m. Posting any errors here.
sam: :eyes: will watch token-latency dashboards, ping if p50 shifts.
luis: Backfill finished. 8/8 shards success. Replayed ~1.2M metrics. Swapping temp namespace -> main now.
otto-bot: Namespace swap executed by @luis — `replay.kvfix.*` -> `metrics.*` at 1761234620
irene: Dashboards refreshed. kvcache.hit_rate tags back in place. Per-route token p50 normalized. Closing loop — good catch.
sam: Great work. Follow-ups: create a small integration test to ensure exporter preserves dotted tags and add the alert rule. I'll file tickets.
